model_output.verdict: A welder and fitter whose resume makes both the work and the inspection results easy to understand.
write_up: This is a strong welding resume! At Maumee Steel Fabricators, you show the processes you use, the fit-up tolerance you work to, and the inspection record on a named job. Your earlier pipe work adds another clear direction. A recruiter can see what kind of welding you do without guessing.
The Riverfront Tower line is the model: it names the job, the inspections, and about how many welds were involved. Your certifications are easy to find, and your experience leads the resume.
The shutdown line is the one I’d work on next. Your resume is unlikely to be the thing holding you back; the jobs available and how competitive they are will also matter.
